verification_policy.verified_exact: Amazon variation data exposed the requested product family, size, color, and pack as the same child ASIN.
verification_policy.approved_substitute: Legacy status name meaning selected, documented substitute identity. It does not mean live offer, fit, seller, price, or checkout approval.
verification_policy.manual_review_exact_candidate: A concrete ASIN/variant was identified from a regional Amazon page or marketplace catalog, but Amazon.com offer/child selection still needs a final manual check.
verification_policy.deployable_rule: deployable denotes prior-research identity readiness only. auto_cart_eligible remains false until live offer review; no purchase is authorized.
verification_policy.manual_review_unresolved: Conflicting child evidence; no purchase ASIN selected. Retain original request and inspect candidate variants when purchasing.

summary.price_note: All subtotal fields sum original-request historical snapshot prices; substitute prices are unverified.
